name: On-Demand Models
description: ON-DEMAND multi-model config; weights (9-16 GB) are NEVER baked into image layers. Owns stack.json manifest (single source of truth for bifrost upstreams and opencode role->model mapping). CLOUD_MODE routes all agents to the hosted opencode provider instead of local slots. Legacy single-model options MODEL/QUANT are deprecated in favor of MODELS.

MODELS.description: JSON array of model specs [{name,provider,hf,quant,port,context,parallel}, ...]. Empty = default single-model (gemma4-26b-a4b). May also be provided via $PWD/.devcontainer/llm-lab-models.json.

ROLES.description: JSON object mapping agent role -> {model, slot}. Empty = default 8-role mapping onto the first model. May also be provided via $PWD/.devcontainer/llm-lab-roles.json.

BIFROST_PORT.description: Bifrost gateway port recorded in stack.json (opencode providers route through it)

MODELS_DIR.description: Custom directory for models; defaults to $PWD/models

CLOUD_MODE.description: Route ALL agents to the hosted opencode provider (cloud) when no explicit MODELS/ROLES are supplied. Set true for GPU-less/cloud boxes. Explicit MODELS (or .devcontainer/llm-lab-models.json) always builds the local slot-pinned stack and wins over CLOUD_MODE.

CLOUD_MODEL.description: Hosted opencode provider model id used by the default cloud role mapping (CLOUD_MODE=true, no ROLES supplied). Override per-role via ROLES or .devcontainer/llm-lab-roles.json.

MODEL.description: (legacy) Hugging Face model repo/filename identifier — superseded by MODELS

QUANT.description: (legacy) Quantization level for the model — superseded by MODELS
